protocol: component holdout (seed 31, 32-pixel interleaving tiles); known catalogue masked; four spatial quadrant blocks pooled; leave-one-fold-out parameter selection per family

proximity.definition: exp(-d/1 km) around known traces, cut at 3 km

external.definition: exp(-d/0.7 km) around derived_sgmc_faults_100m_u8, derived_gdr_paleo_100m_u8, derived_gdr_2m_probes_100m_u8, derived_gdr_volcanics_100m_u8
external.excluded: derived_gdr_qfaults_v2_100m_u8 (59,037/59,065 px on the training catalogue)

hybrid.definition: geometric mean of proximity and external

gbm.leak_warning: the shipped model trained on the whole catalogue, so this field is contaminated on this frame; operator comparison only
